verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is documented as an isolated microVM environment for running agent-generated or untrusted code, not as a product with its own built-in AI assistant that users delegate tasks to. The default image 'includes ... coding agents', but preinstalled tooling inside the runtime is an adjacent feature, not a first-party in-product assistant. No evidence shows an assistant in the dashboard, CLI or SDK that accepts delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
